description: This file defines a class for managing desktop entry files and includes functions for updating, installing, and uninstalling desktop menu entries, specifically for the Menulibre application.

classes.name: MenulibreDesktopEntry
classes.description: A class for handling desktop entry (.desktop) files, including loading, property access, and action retrieval.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a MenulibreDesktopEntry instance, optionally loading from a file.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the desktop entry.

methods.name: __setitem__
methods.description: Sets a property value in the desktop entry.

methods.name: load_properties
methods.description: Loads properties from a specified file.

methods.name: get_property
methods.description: Returns the value of a specified property, considering locale.

methods.name: get_named_property
methods.description: Returns the value of a named property, with locale support for certain keys.

methods.name: get_actions
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of action groups associated with the desktop entry.

methods.name: _get_action_group_name
methods.description: Extracts the action group name from a group string.

methods.name: _get_locale_string
methods.description: Retrieves a locale-specific string for a property.

methods.name: _set_locale_string
methods.description: Sets a locale-specific string for a property.

methods.name: _get_string_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of strings for a property.

methods.name: _get_groups
methods.description: Returns all groups in the keyfile.

methods.name: _get_keys
methods.description: Returns all keys in a specified group.
